title: Stuck 'Paste ⋯' box appears unasked at the top-left of the Maestro window and cannot be closed
summary: A Chromium touch-text 'Paste' quick menu could appear stuck at the window's top-left; Maestro now starts WebView2 with TouchTextEditingRedesign enabled (keeping Tauri's defaults) on every window from one shared definition, and cancels touch/pen context menus in the page. Closing a menu that still appears is impossible from Maestro and is recorded as such.
friction: CLAUDE.md states a skip-count baseline of 0, but cargo test --workspace already reports 1 ignored test on main; every dev and reviewer has to re-check whether a story changed it
lessons_learned: The trigger for the touch-text menu on a mouse-and-touchpad machine is unproven: CDP touch input produced no context menu, so only the maintainer's hand check after the next update confirms the fix
